records.source_counting_note: The Results opening reports eight early stops for an EB score of at least four. Table 1 contains five participant-exposures with an EB grade of four, and Section 2.9 distinguishes in-chamber and offline readings. The Results also describe limiting comparison times in affected participants. The report supplies no individual linkage between the stop times and Table 1, or case count for DCS.
